Aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pi: Izithombe zasemoyeni ezicishe zibe ngamamitha angu-0.3 kuya ku-1 nge-pixel emadolobheni amaningi, ezingacacile kangako emaphandleni: zicace ngokwanele ukubona imizila, imiphetho yemigwaqo nojantshi. Izinsuku zezithombe ziyehluka ngokwendawo.
Esri World Imagery as an aerial basemap:: I-Esri World Imagery njengemephu eyisisekelo yasemoyeni: izithombe zasemoyeni ezicishe zibe ngamamitha angu-0.3 kuya ku-1 nge-pixel emadolobheni amaningi, ezicace ngokwanele ukubona imizila, imiphetho yemigwaqo nojantshi. Inikezwa uma uMphathi esegcine ukhiye we-ArcGIS API futhi wamukela imigomo ye-Esri ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuphatha → Ama-plugin; amathayela adlula kule MobSimLab, ngakho iziphequluli azilokothi zibone ukhiye, futhi awagcinwa.
